claims.text: The architecture of the span detector includes a SAN answer module and a one-layer feed forward neural network for binary classification.
The span detector is part of an extended SAN that includes a binary classifier, both of which are jointly optimized.
The span detector and binary classifier share the same lower layer but have separate top layers for their respective tasks.
A multi-turn answer module is adopted for the span detector.
